Le quatrième Recensement Général de la P: The fourth General Population and Housing Census (4th GPHC) and the General Agriculture and Livestock Census (GALC) are large-scale statistical operations for the country's development planning.
Le 4ème RGPH est institué par Décret Pré: The 4th GPHC was instituted by Presidential Decree No. 2015/397 of September 15, 2015, while the GALC was instituted by Presidential Decree No. 2015/292 of June 29, 2015.
Les activités de mutualisation ont été i: Mutualization activities were instructed in 2019 by the Prime Minister, Head of Government, in order to optimize the costs related to the operationalization of these activities.
Le 4ème RGPH a pour objectif général de: The 4th GPHC's general objective is to make available the data necessary for development planning and the inclusion of the demographic dividend in the formulation of policies allowing Cameroon to evolve towards emergence.
Le RGAE a en revanche pour objectif géné: The GALC, on the other hand, aims to provide sufficiently disaggregated structural statistical information on all agropastoral and aquaculture farms, and to develop sampling frames for complementary and thematic modules and surveys of the Permanent and Integrated System of Agropastoral Statistics (SPISA).
Cet instrument précieux permet le cadrag: This valuable instrument allows for the framing, development, monitoring, and evaluation of public policies at national, regional, and local levels. It serves as a basis for:
L'élaboration des bases de sondage pour: Development of sampling frames for inter-censal surveys.
La planification des infrastructures de: Planning of basic infrastructure (schools, hospitals, roads).
L'opération adopte une approche numériqu: The operation adopts a modern digital approach (CAPI - Computer Assisted Personal Interviewing) using tablets and smartphones to guarantee the quality and speed of collection.
Découpage du pays en zones de dénombreme: Mapping the country into enumeration areas (EA).
Test grandeur nature des outils et de l': Full-scale testing of tools and organization.
Traitement, apurement et publication des: Processing, cleaning, and publication of results.
Retrouvez les réponses aux questions les: Find answers to the most frequently asked questions about the 4th GPHC and the GALC.
Le recensement permet de connaître préci: The census allows for a precise understanding of the population and its needs to better plan infrastructure (schools, hospitals, roads) and guide public policies for Cameroon's development.
Comment vérifier mon agent recenseur ?: How to verify my census agent?
Chaque agent porte un gilet officiel jau: Each agent wears an official yellow vest with the logo and has an identification badge with their photo, name, and the BUCREP's official stamp. If in doubt, scan the QR code on their badge or call the toll-free number.
Nous collectons des informations démogra: We collect demographic information (age, gender), socio-economic (profession, education), health, and housing data. No banking information or secret codes will ever be requested.
Oui, participer au recensement est une o: Yes, participating in the census is a civic duty. An accurate count is essential for the State to allocate budgets and public services equitably in each region.
Absolument. Conformément à la loi sur le: Absolutely. In accordance with the law on statistical secrecy, your individual information is strictly confidential. It is anonymized and used only to produce global statistics.
Comment participer au recrutement des ag: How to participate in agent recruitment?
Vous pouvez postuler directement sur ce: You can apply directly on this portal via the 'Become a Census Agent' button. Criteria include educational level (minimum Baccalaureate), mastery of local languages, and residency in the collection area.
Le BUCREP déploie des protocoles de sécu: BUCREP deploys state-of-the-art security protocols to guarantee the absolute secrecy and confidentiality of every citizen's declaration.
Conformément à la loi sur le secret stat: In accordance with the law on statistical secrecy, your individual information remains strictly confidential and protected.
La collecte s'effectue sur des tablettes: The collection is done via secure digital tablets. Entered data is immediately encrypted and securely transmitted to BUCREP's central server.
Aucune donnée fiscale, bancaire ou nomin: No tax, banking, or personal data is ever disclosed. The collected information is used exclusively to plan Cameroon's national development.

Les 7 Grandes Phases du RGPH: The 7 Great Phases of the GPHC
Une opération de cette envergure se déro: An operation of this scale takes place rigorously in several successive phases, from the initial framing to the final publication.
Conception des méthodologies, élaboratio: Methodology design, development of questionnaires, collection tools, instruction manuals, and mobilization of financial, material, and human resources.
Mise à jour exhaustive du fichier des lo: Comprehensive update of the localities file and partitioning of the national territory into work zones called Enumeration Areas (EA). One agent will be deployed per EA.
Test grandeur nature de l'ensemble de l': Full-scale testing of the entire organization and methodologies on a representative sample of approximately 260 urban and rural enumeration areas.
Le comptage effectif de la population et: The actual counting of the population and collection of data from each household by census agents equipped with smartphones. Responding is a civic duty.
Réalisée au plus tard trois mois après l: Conducted at most three months after the main enumeration to evaluate geographic coverage and the quality of key variables (gender and age) across 12 strata.
Traitement transversal, apurement rigour: Transversal processing, rigorous cleaning, and in-depth statistical analysis to develop priority analysis volumes and regional monographs.
Mise à disposition et vulgarisation des: Provision and popularization of official results on various accessible media, to facilitate their understanding and use by decision-makers.
Le Gouvernement a opté pour la méthode C: The Government opted for the CAPI method (Computer-Assisted Personal Interviewing) using smartphones during data collection for several strategic reasons:
Raccourcissement significatif du délai d: Significant shortening of the time required to make official results available.
Élimination complète des phases manuelle: Complete elimination of manual paper verification, data entry, and recoding phases.
Les données transmises sont protégées pa: Transmitted data is protected by statistical secrecy and encrypted end-to-end.

partner_wb_desc: The World Bank supports the census through the HISWACA project, providing key funding for digital equipment, CAPI tablets and training of field agents.
partner_hiswaca_desc: The HISWACA programme coordinates technical and financial support for statistical operations in Central African countries, including Cameroon, as part of a regional cooperation effort.
partner_gvt_desc: The Cameroonian Government provides the majority of funding through the State budget and national coordination through MINEPAT, the technical supervisory authority of BUCREP.
partner_unfpa_desc: UNFPA provides cutting-edge demographic expertise for the design of data collection tools, digital mapping and real-time monitoring of field operations.
partner_fao_desc: FAO oversees the agricultural component of the census (RGAE), providing standardised methodologies, international agricultural nomenclatures and technical support for agropastoral data.
partner_oms_desc: WHO contributes to the operational logistics of the census, particularly for the provision of technical materials and support for operations in hard-to-reach areas.
partner_bucrep_desc: A public agency created in 1999, BUCREP is the government's operational arm. It coordinates all operations, from mapping through to the publication of results.
partner_minepat_desc: MINEPAT oversees the strategic direction of the census and ensures its integration into national planning and sustainable development policies.
partner_ins_desc: The National Institute of Statistics collaborates with BUCREP on methodological validation, nomenclature consistency and the dissemination of results to users.

comm_section_faq_sub: Official BUCREP answers to the most common questions.
comm_faq1_q: Will my data be passed on to the tax authorities or police?
comm_faq1_a: No. Data collected during the census is strictly confidential and is never passed on to the tax authorities, police or any other government body. It is used exclusively to produce anonymised national statistics, in accordance with statistical legislation.
comm_faq2_q: Does the census serve to identify political opponents?
comm_faq2_a: Absolutely not. The census is a purely statistical operation with no link to politics. Its aim is to count the population in order to plan public services — health, education, water supply. Statistical secrecy is guaranteed by law.
comm_faq3_q: Will RGPH4 data be made public?
comm_faq3_a: Yes, but only in the form of aggregated, anonymised statistics. No individual data will ever be published. Results will be progressively available on the official INS and BUCREP platforms, accessible to the general public.
comm_faq4_q: Can I refuse to answer the enumerator's questions?
comm_faq4_a: Participation is mandatory under Cameroonian statistical law. Refusal or providing false information is punishable. Agents are instructed to explain each question and put households at ease.
comm_faq5_q: Must foreigners and non-Cameroonian residents participate?
comm_faq5_a: Yes. The census counts all persons habitually residing in Cameroon, regardless of nationality. This includes regular foreign residents, recognised refugees and anyone present on the territory. Their data remains confidential.
comm_faq6_q: Will the census affect my access to land or social assistance?
comm_faq6_a: No. The census does not affect your land rights, allowances or social assistance in any way. It is used to plan future public investments (roads, hospitals, schools) based on the actual distribution of the population.
comm_faq7_q: How can I tell if the enumerator is official?
comm_faq7_a: Every official agent wears an identifiable uniform and carries an official BUCREP mission card with photo, name and assigned region. They use an Android tablet with the official data collection app. If in doubt, call (+237) 6 93 87 31 45.
comm_faq8_q: Does a woman living alone have to open her door to an enumerator?
comm_faq8_a: Agents only visit during daytime hours and can be received outdoors (courtyard, veranda). You may ask a trusted neighbour to be present. The agent must always show their official card before starting.
comm_faq9_q: When will RGPH4 results be available?
comm_faq9_a: The first provisional results are expected in the months following the end of data collection. Definitive and detailed results will be published progressively on the official BUCREP and INS platforms, accessible to the general public.
